text:
sam_sales: MerchantOne ready to finalize commit. They require sustained 5k RPS for peak windows, short 2x bursts, and 200ms p95. Asking for reserved GPU slab + burst-credit pricing. Need eng sizing + autoscale recs.

violet_sre: Quick clarify avg sequence length and % rerank?

sam_sales: Avg ~360 tokens, rerank ~7%. Mostly single-turn generation.

chao_prod: With seq~360 and a batching cap to keep p95 <200ms, assume ~800 rps per A100-eq GPU. That implies ~7 reserved GPUs. KV cache warmup can add ~20% effective throughput.

rajesh_infra: For 2x 10m bursts: recommend a 5-GPU burst pool. Spot-backed for cost, but document eviction fallback to an 8-bit quantized variant. Preheat 10m before campaigns to warm KV.

nora_se: Security checklist: CMEK/KMS supported, VPC peering OK, audit log export to their S3, SOC2 addendum required (legal ETA ~5 business days). No technical blockers.

violet_sre: Autoscale draft: monitor 30s RPS avg, scale up when >85% of reserved for 60s, cooldown 120s. Use burst pool up to configured max. If burst not provisioned within 120s, automated fallback to quantized model and then 429s for excess requests; notify via webhook.

chao_prod: Recommend contract matrix listing baseline (full-precision), fallback (8-bit), and degraded (smaller model) with deterministic latency numbers to avoid dispute.

rajesh_infra: Preheat curl: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.example/v1/preheat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"job":"kv_warm","model":"merchant-chat","start_in":"10m","duration_mins":15}'`

sam_sales: Action items: (1) @chao_prod perf table + GPU counts by EOD. (2) @rajesh_infra runbook + preheat snippet. (3) @nora_se security checklist + SOC2 timeline. (4) @violet_sre SLA blurb & 429 policy. I'll package for finance/legal.

ops_bot: Reminder: Dedicated provisioning needs RFC + AZ affinity: https://rfd.redwood.example/reqs/10001
